This file provides guidance to Claude Code (claude.ai/code) when working with code in this repository.

Modern, enterprise-grade dotfiles repo: progressive complexity, intelligent performance optimization, comprehensive dev tools. Multi-platform support (macOS, Linux, WSL) with tier-based configurations for shell, tmux, Neovim.

Commands/examples:
./install.sh install standard
./install.sh install minimal     # Essential tools only
./install.sh install full        # Complete setup with AI tools
./install.sh install ai_focused  # AI-enhanced development
./install.sh --dry-run install standard
./install.sh link
dot setup
dot check
dot update
dot reload
dot project init
dot ai review
dot security scan
dot metrics dashboard
dot plugin list
dot migrate status
./tests/test_runner.sh
dot test quick
./tests/test_runner.sh --category infrastructure
find . -name "*.sh" -exec shellcheck {} \;
find . -name "*.yaml" -o -name "*.yml" | xargs yamllint
dot check
dot doctor
dot test run
perf-status
perf-bench
perf-quick

Layout:
**`bin/`** DOT CLI/utilities (main interface)
**`config/`** templates/core configs
**`lib/`** core libraries by functionality
**`plugins/`** modular plugin system
**`scripts/`** install/utility scripts
**`tests/`** comprehensive testing framework

Main interface: `dot` in `bin/dot`. Orchestrates via `lib/cli/`:
`core.sh` (setup/check/update)
`ai.sh` (AI integration/code assistance)
`security.sh` (security scanning/hardening)
`project.sh` (project init/management)
`testing.sh` (test execution/reporting)

Declarative approach: `config/tools.yaml`. Profiles: minimal, standard, full, ai_focused. Platform detection auto OS/distro with right package managers. Tier-based complexity: progressive feature unlocking for shell/tmux/Neovim.

Core plugins: `plugins/core/` ; community: `plugins/community/` ; local: `plugins/local/` .
Plugin template: `plugins/local/hello-world/` .

Tier system:
Tier 1: 8 essential plugins
Tier 2: 23 plugins
Tier 3: 33+ plugins

Neovim:
`config/nvim/init.lua` entry.
`config/nvim/lua/core/` core configs/tier management
`config/nvim/lua/tiers/` tier-specific plugin definitions
`config/nvim/lua/languages/` language settings

tmux:
`config/tmux/tmux.conf` main
`config/tmux/core.conf` core keybindings/settings
Essential bindings: Ctrl-a prefix, hjkl navigation, | and - for splits

Zsh:
`config/zsh/` modular shell config
Performance modes: fast (<300ms), balanced (<500ms), full (<1000ms)
Auto-detect resources/optimization; enhanced autosuggestions/history management

Tool/plugin workflow:
1. Edit `config/tools.yaml` to define the tool
2. Add to appropriate group (essential, development, optional)
3. Test with `./install.sh --dry-run install
